title: Json/XML Node Notation
description: This schema describes JXNN – a JSON encoding of XML's data shape.

JXNN.title: Base JXNN schema representation of XML element node.
JXNN.description: JXNN schema allows for three kinds of properties: JSON-specific (starting with '$'), xml-specific (starting with '$') xml attributes (starting with '@').

$schema.title: JXNN JSON Schema
$schema.description: A reference to JSON schema of JXNN.

?origin.title: Origin XML node
?origin.description: A stringified copy of the XML from which the JXNN was derived. May be used for debugging purposes.

@.+.title: XML Attribute Node
@.+.description: An XML attribute. The value must be always a string.
@.+.$comment: We allow only string values because JXNN represents data from the perspective of XML, not JSON. If conversion from JSON to XML using JXNN happens, all nummeric values must be stringified.

TextNode.title: Text Node
TextNode.description: JXNN representation of an XML Text Node ('unstructured content')

ElementNode.title: Element Node
ElementNode.description: JXNN representation of an XML Element Node ('structured content')

?tag.title: XML Element Name.
?tag.description: Complete name of the XML element ('tag').

?*.title: XML children elements
?*.description: Representing XML children as an array.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: JXNN representation of an XML Node.
